newsitem.title: USA: CKS Group acquires McKinney & Silver.
newsitem.headline: CKS Group acquires McKinney & Silver.

text.p: CKS Group Inc said Monday it had acquired McKinney & Silver for about $24 million in stock to be accounted for as a pooling of interest.
McKinney & Silver, which has 125 employees, is an award-winning advertising firm best known for its campaigns on behalf of Audi and Royal Caribbean Cruise Lines.
"We can't wait to see what will happen when they tap into our new media capabilities," said Mark Kvamme, CKS chairman and chief executive.
McKinney said in a statement it will work with CKS Group to help clients navigate through a dramatically changing media landscape.
CKS Group is a marketing communications firm that helps companies market their products and services in a variety of media including the Internet.
